segments.summary: Exact review confirmed the reviewer remediation filter, rerun, prompt, comparison, outcome, and post-gate contracts; adversarial review found unresolved registry, trust, concurrency, gate-failure, and rollback semantics.

Exact review confirmed canonical continuity, active-child projection, safe-hook degradation, and compatibility-only side files; adversarial review found lifecycle, atomicity, access, expiry, and partial-output consumer gaps.

Exact review confirmed canonical-expiry precedence, one-retry handoff enforcement, platform validation, and orchestrator/parser ownership; adversarial review found downgrade, offline, retry, partial-minimum, and equivalence-oracle gaps.

Exact review confirmed hook ordering, native fallback, parser recovery, version tracking, and bounded remediation; adversarial review found ordering, mutation, cancellation, timeout, migration, and parent-authority ambiguity.

Exact review confirmed retired memory heuristics, identity tracking, selective safe wrapping, and permission fallback; adversarial review found spoofing, races, benchmark, temporary-storage, cleanup, and privacy gaps.

Exact review confirmed format prompting, adapters, best-effort extraction, retry context, and performance techniques; adversarial review found missing injection defenses, protocol bounds, redaction, rollback, cache invalidation, and async determinism.

Exact review confirmed handoff minimums, false-positive target, compatibility placement, remediation placement, and selector caching; adversarial review found raw-log privacy, oracle, parser ownership, reconciliation, and invalidation gaps.

Exact review confirmed selector fallback, availability, parallelism, override, multi-language, non-executable lineage, and module placement; adversarial review found race, cache, authority, isolation, merge, offline, scale, and ownership gaps.
